sky_banner_aura.name: Sky Banner Aura
sky_banner_aura.normal_rules_text: Allied units get +1/+1 and {KW:flying} while this unit is alive.

sentinels_tithe.name: Sentinel's Tithe
sentinels_tithe.normal_rules_text: Whenever this unit deals damage to an enemy unit and {GL:survives|survives}, gain 2 {GL:flux_energy|flux energy} (max 4 per turn).

titans_tithe.name: Titan's Tithe
titans_tithe.normal_rules_text: Whenever this unit deals damage to an enemy unit and {GL:survives|survives}, gain 4 {GL:flux_energy|flux energy} (max 12 per turn).

mortar_barrage_passive.name: Mortar Barrage
mortar_barrage_passive.normal_rules_text: At the end of your turn, deal 3 damage and apply 1 {FX:overload} to a random enemy unit within range 4 (minimum range 2) and all entities adjacent to that unit.

final_barrage_detonation_passive.name: Final Barrage Detonation
final_barrage_detonation_passive.normal_rules_text: At the start of your turn, if this building was primed by Final Barrage, fire Mortar Barrage 6 times, then self-destruct dealing 3 damage and 1 {FX:overload} to all adjacent entities.

replication_protocol.name: Replication Protocol
replication_protocol.normal_rules_text: Whenever this structure deals damage to an enemy, spawn a Replicator Bot token on a random unoccupied adjacent tile to that enemy (if one is available). The bot's attack and health equal the damage dealt. The bot spawns {FX:stunned}.

surrounding_buff_mirror.name: Resonance Echo
surrounding_buff_mirror.normal_rules_text: Whenever a surrounding unit (allied or enemy) gains a {FX:boost}, this unit also gains a copy of that {FX:boost}.

hyperactive_scanning.name: Hyperactive Scanning
hyperactive_scanning.normal_rules_text: Temporarily gain the keywords of surrounding units.

vulturous_nanites.name: Vulturous Nanites
vulturous_nanites.normal_rules_text: {KW:last_gasp}: when this unit dies, spawn a melee token at its location with half its base attack and HP (rounded down); the token spawns {FX:stunned}.

starforged_feast_passive.name: Starforged Feast
starforged_feast_passive.normal_rules_text: At the end of your turn, consume all {GL:flux_energy|flux energy} not generated by zones. Gain +1 permanent damage and +1 permanent max HP for each point consumed.

the_macrowave_pulse.name: The Macrowave Pulse
the_macrowave_pulse.normal_rules_text: At the end of this unit's owner's turn, deal 3 damage to all surrounding units (allies and enemies).

core_cracker_prime_passive.name: Cold Start
core_cracker_prime_passive.normal_rules_text: At the start of each of your turns (except the turn this unit was deployed), this unit cannot move, attack, use abilities, or react until you pay 3 gallantry (channeled) to Prime Core.

core_cracker_advance_passive.name: Crushing Advance
core_cracker_advance_passive.normal_rules_text: Cannot gain {FX:bonus_move_grant}-points or extra moves. Can move to any tile regardless of occupancy, except tiles containing an {KW:indestructible} entity or another Core Cracker. When moving to an occupied tile, entities there take 3 damage and are pushed to a surrounding tile (destroyed if none available). This push ignores {KW:immovable}.

forward_depot_supply_passive.name: Resonance Supply
forward_depot_supply_passive.normal_rules_text: At the start of your turn, gain 3 {GL:flux_energy|flux energy}.

boss_ability_aura.name: Command Presence
boss_ability_aura.normal_rules_text: Allied units within range 1 deal +1 damage with activated abilities.

inspiring_commander_aura.name: Inspiring Presence
inspiring_commander_aura.normal_rules_text: Surrounding allied units (Chebyshev 1) gain +1 damage and +1 maximum HP.

diesel_rider_movement_refresh.name: Full Throttle
diesel_rider_movement_refresh.normal_rules_text: Whenever this unit deals damage to an enemy, restore one full move action.

valiant_resolute_iron_will.name: Iron Will
valiant_resolute_iron_will.normal_rules_text: When damage would kill this unit, 50% chance to survive at 1 HP instead. If triggered and this unit was not already {FX:stunned}, gain 1 {FX:stunned|stun} stack. Then permanently gain +2 attack and +2 max HP.

shock_wire_shock_retaliation.name: Shock Retaliation
shock_wire_shock_retaliation.normal_rules_text: Whenever a unit melee attacks this structure and deals damage, that attacker receives 1 {FX:overload}. Hybrid units using their ranged attack do not trigger this, even at melee range.

ape_foreman_structure_aura.name: Reinforced Foundations
ape_foreman_structure_aura.normal_rules_text: Allied structures adjacent to this unit gain +2 max HP.

sanglante_bloodlust.name: Bloodlust
sanglante_bloodlust.normal_rules_text: Whenever this unit kills an enemy unit, permanently gain +1/+1.

callahan_sworn_protector.name: Sworn Protector
callahan_sworn_protector.normal_rules_text: Whenever a unit you were covering dies, gain +1 {KW:multistrike} for 2 turns. Stacks once per unit death; each new death refreshes the duration.

spellcasting_squire_mana_passive.name: Arcane Proximity
spellcasting_squire_mana_passive.rules_text: Temporary {T} expires at end of turn.
spellcasting_squire_mana_passive.normal_rules_text: At the start of your turn, if an enemy unit is within 2 tiles, gain 1 {GL:flux_energy|flux energy}.

orphic_knight_spellbound.name: Spellbound
orphic_knight_spellbound.normal_rules_text: Whenever you play a spell, gain +1 damage this turn.

mana_frog_death_passive.name: Mana Release
mana_frog_death_passive.rules_text: Floating {T} expires when the active turn ends, even if gained on the opponent's turn.
mana_frog_death_passive.normal_rules_text: When this unit dies, gain 3 {GL:flux_energy|flux energy} before the current turn ends.

magus_apprentice_spellbound.name: Spellbound
magus_apprentice_spellbound.normal_rules_text: Whenever you play a spell, gain 1 Arcane Charge.

silvermane_cavalry_trophy_conduit.name: Trophy of the Hunt
silvermane_cavalry_trophy_conduit.normal_rules_text: When you defeat an enemy unit, gain 1 {KW:conduit} permanently.

ancient_frog_store_passive.name: Reservoir
ancient_frog_store_passive.rules_text: Tap zones manually during your turn to bank more float; this does not tap zones for you. Multiple reservoir units split energy evenly (turn order gets +1 remainder pips).
ancient_frog_store_passive.normal_rules_text: At the end of your turn, consume all your floating energy and store it (max 16).

ancient_frog_release_passive.name: Mana Burst
ancient_frog_release_passive.normal_rules_text: When this unit dies, grant all stored energy as {GL:flux_energy|flux energy}.

valgar_devourers_trophy.name: Devourer's Trophy
valgar_devourers_trophy.normal_rules_text: Whenever this unit kills an enemy unit, draw a card (max 3 times per turn).

valgar_insatiable_focus.name: Insatiable Focus
valgar_insatiable_focus.rules_text: Arm the spell, click Valgar, then pick a target in range and line of sight from him.
valgar_insatiable_focus.normal_rules_text: While this unit is on the board, non-{KW:focus} damaging spells you cast must be cast through this unit as a {KW:focus} caster with {RANGE} 2.

seraphina_spellbound.name: Spellbound
seraphina_spellbound.rules_text: Symphony of the Scorching Sphere expires at the end of your next turn.
seraphina_spellbound.normal_rules_text: Whenever you play a spell, gain 1 Resonance; at 3 Resonance, create Symphony of the Scorching Sphere in your hand and remove 3 Resonance.

seraphina_scorching_acceleration.name: Scorching Acceleration
seraphina_scorching_acceleration.normal_rules_text: You may play Symphony of the Scorching Sphere at {REFLEX} speed.

mana_pylon_charge_supply_passive.name: Charge Reservoir
mana_pylon_charge_supply_passive.normal_rules_text: At the start of your turn, gain a charge.

mana_pylon_conduit_passive.name: Spell Conduit
mana_pylon_conduit_passive.rules_text: In team games, teammates' damaging spells count. Oldest deployed pylon with a {KW:charge} reacts first.
mana_pylon_conduit_passive.normal_rules_text: Whenever an allied damaging spell is cast, consume a {KW:charge} and add {KW:conduit} 1 to that spell cast.

defective_construct_spellbound.name: Spellbound
defective_construct_spellbound.rules_text: Does not grant another movement action.
defective_construct_spellbound.normal_rules_text: Whenever you play a spell, gain +1 movement speed this turn.

war_time_belles_march.name: March Aura
war_time_belles_march.normal_rules_text: At the start of your turn, all surrounding allied units gain +1 movement this turn.

lady_concordia_promise.name: Concordia's Promise
lady_concordia_promise.normal_rules_text: When an allied unit within range 2 takes damage from an enemy, permanently gain +1 attack damage and heal 1 HP.

glorious_standard_sentinel_veil.name: Sentinel Veil
glorious_standard_sentinel_veil.normal_rules_text: Surrounding allied units each have a once-per-turn death prevention: the first time they would die this turn while in range, they survive at 1 HP instead.

electrified_death_ball_shock_field.name: Shock Field
electrified_death_ball_shock_field.normal_rules_text: Damage this unit does applies 1 {FX:overload} to each unit it damages.

clawbreaker_overload_strikes.name: Overload Strikes
clawbreaker_overload_strikes.normal_rules_text: Damage this unit does applies 1 {FX:overload} to each unit it damages.

clawbreaker_bleeding_strikes.name: Bleeding Strikes
clawbreaker_bleeding_strikes.normal_rules_text: Damage this unit does applies 1 {FX:bleed} to each unit it damages.

shock_bot_overload_strikes.name: Overload on Hit
shock_bot_overload_strikes.normal_rules_text: Damage this unit does applies 1 {FX:overload} to each unit it damages.

raging_volt_spire_overload_hardening.name: Overload Hardening
raging_volt_spire_overload_hardening.normal_rules_text: Takes half damage from {FX:overload} explosions and retains all {FX:overload} stacks after exploding. Incoming {FX:overload} applications are halved (floor).

raging_volt_spire_volt_feed.name: Volt Feed
raging_volt_spire_volt_feed.normal_rules_text: Whenever any other unit within {RANGE}2 explodes from {FX:overload}, this unit gains those stacks. Does not absorb stacks from other Volt Feed units' explosions.

flame_trooper_incendiary_rounds.name: Incendiary Rounds
flame_trooper_incendiary_rounds.normal_rules_text: Damage this unit does applies 2 {FX:fire} to each unit it damages.

flame_trooper_last_gasp_fire.name: Last Gasp: Inferno
flame_trooper_last_gasp_fire.normal_rules_text: When this unit dies, set its tile and adjacent tiles on fire for 2 turns.

fumigant_gas_emission.name: Gas Emission
fumigant_gas_emission.normal_rules_text: Damage this unit does places a gas cloud on each tile it damages for 2 of your turn-ends and applies 1 {FX:poison} to each unit on it (including {KW:cleave} hits).

miasma_gas_emission.name: Gas Emission
miasma_gas_emission.normal_rules_text: Damage this unit does places a gas cloud on each tile it damages for 2 of your turn-ends and applies 1 {FX:poison} to each unit on it (including {KW:cleave} hits).

starforged_tithe.name: Starforged Tithe
starforged_tithe.normal_rules_text: Whenever this unit deals damage to an enemy unit and {GL:survives|survives}, gain 1 {GL:flux_energy|flux energy} (max 2 per turn).

rangers_tithe.name: Ranger's Tithe
rangers_tithe.normal_rules_text: Whenever this unit deals damage to an enemy unit and {GL:survives|survives}, gain 3 {GL:flux_energy|flux energy} (max 6 per turn).
